leftEvidence.title: The fruit is taken and both eat

points.label: Actors in view
points.left: The serpent questions the command, the woman sees and takes the fruit, gives it to her husband with her, and both become aware of their nakedness.
points.right: Paul says sin entered through one man and death through sin, then names Adam and describes death reigning from Adam to Moses.

points.label: Source setting
points.left: Tree, hiding, and judgment · core · Genesis 3:1–7
points.right: Adam, Christ, and embodied life · later memory · Romans 5:12–14

payload.posture: The woman takes and gives, and her husband with her eats is held beside Sin enters through one man, death through sin, and Adam is named.

rightEvidence.title: Romans traces sin and death through one man

payload.tension: Genesis narrates several actors, while Romans selects one man when tracing sin and death into the world.
payload.title: The garden action and Romans’ one-man claim
